hook: Your wing nut would flip itself in space.
title: A Wing Nut Flips Itself in Space
description:
Spin a T-handle or wing nut in zero gravity and it tumbles over, then spins steadily, then tumbles again. It is called the Dzhanibekov effect, and it has been filmed on camera in orbit. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Space #IfYouWereInSpace
comment_prompt: Did you expect that? Yes or no
